'''Ishida''' is a female NPC student, who is seen at the Infirmary with her teacher, '''Ms. Yuki'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Ishida:''' Sensei, I'm really fine… See? I can move just fine. I'm quick, I'm nimble, good as new!

:'''Ms. Yuki:''' …I'm checking your consciousness map and stress diagnostics again.

:'''Ms. Yuki:''' Everything looks normal… Sigh. Just don't go overboard in your next Synchronist Test, okay?

:'''Ms. Yuki:''' You need more than just a strong Forte to become a Synchronist. What matters more is understanding it, so you are able to sync and power up the Exostrider's "Drive."

:'''Ms. Yuki:''' I know how badly you want this. I've just seen too many students burn out chasing it...

:'''Ms. Yuki:''' I'll be proud if you become a Synchronist. But I'd rather see you graduate in one piece.

:'''Ms. Yuki:''' Anywhere else that feels uncomfortable?

:'''Ishida:''' If anything… I'm just a little hungry…

:'''Ms. Yuki:''' Come on. To the cafeteria we go then. I'll treat you with my card.
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:;'''Ms. Yuki''' During the rune search, your frequency readings spiked past the safety limit several times.

:;'''Ms. Yuki''' Your resonance patterns are still within the safety range, but...

:;'''[[Ishida]]''' Wasn't me. Didn't happen. I swear on my credits.

:In the infirmary, a student fresh out of his medical check-up seems to be trying very hard to explain himself to a teacher.

:{{DIcon|Option}} (Listen)
::'''Ms. Yuki:''' I understand. Most Synchronists would stay behind in their mechs and hold the line, buying time for everyone else.

::'''Ms. Yuki:''' Maybe you can fool I.R.I.S. and N.A.N.A., but you can't fool me... This isn't the first time you've pushed yourself toward Overclocking, is it?

::'''Ishida:''' How did you know...? Is it because you're from Ashinohara too, Professor?

::'''Ms. Yuki:''' Wrong. It's because this technique originated from Rabelle College.

::'''Ms. Yuki:''' Listen to me, Ishida. You're just an ordinary person who happened to develop a Forte. You are not obligated to throw your life away for the Synchronist Program.

::'''Ms. Yuki:''' I understand how you feel. But the closer you get to Overclocking, the easier it is to trigger an accident no one can control.

::'''Ms. Yuki:''' And besides... the Synchronist Program itself may not be around much longer.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} (Leave)
{{Dialogue End}}
